slides.title: Make it *interview you*
slides.prompt: Before you answer, ask me 5 questions that would change your answer. Wait for my replies.
slides.why: Generic answers come from generic questions. This makes it tailor everything to you.

slides.title: Find your *money leaks*
slides.prompt: Here are my last 3 bank statements. List every recurring charge, what it costs per year, and flag the ones I might have forgotten.
slides.why: Most people find at least one charge they forgot. Takes 2 minutes.

slides.title: Get a *smart skeptic*
slides.prompt: Here is my plan. Argue against it like a sharp skeptic, then give me the one change that fixes the biggest risk.
slides.why: It agrees with you too easily. This makes it push back.

slides.title: Make it *write like you*
slides.prompt: Here are 3 messages I wrote. Describe my style in 5 rules. Then rewrite this draft using those rules.
slides.why: No more robotic replies. Your voice, faster.

slides.title: Get your *money back*
slides.prompt: Here is my receipt and what went wrong. Write a short, polite refund request that names my rights and asks for a reply within 7 days.
slides.why: Works for double charges, late deliveries and canceled flights.

cta.small: Want the full agent that hunts your forgotten subscriptions every month? Comment SUBS and we will DM it to you.

note: Works in Claude, and in ChatGPT too.
